annotations.title: Energy rating, MEES and the retrofit gap

description:
The energy picture for one property: current rating against the
    certificate's own potential, the points and letter bands available, the
    fabric and heating the assessor recorded, and MEES.

    MEES IS A LEGAL BAR, NOT A VALUATION NOTE. An F or G cannot lawfully be let
    on a new or continuing tenancy in England and Wales without a registered
    exemption. Report it as a constraint on what the owner may do, not as a
    discount to apply.

    A band letter is a RANGE — G spans 19 SAP points, D spans 13 — and the
    range is on the response. A null gap means unknown, never "already at
    potential".

    `recommended_measures` reads `not_available` (gap G3): the assessor's own
    improvement list with indicative costs is published by MHCLG in a file we
    do not load. Do NOT substitute a generic list of retrofit measures — it
    would read as this property's assessment. No pound figure is put on the
    uplift either; the elasticity is local and contested and we have not
    estimated one.
    UK only. Costs 5 credits (5p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_energy_retrofit
